[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (n: Nat) : Bool :=
if n < 2 then
  false
else
  let rec is_prime_helper (k: Nat) : Bool :=
    if k * k > n then
      true
    else if n % k = 0 then
      false
    else
      is_prime_helper (k + 1)
  is_prime_helper 2
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma is_prime_helper_correct (k: Nat) (n: Nat) (h_k_squared_gt_n: k * k > n) (h_not_divisible: ∀ m, 2 ≤ m ∧ m < n → n % m ≠ 0) : is_prime_helper k n = true :=
by
  unfold is_prime_helper
  simp [h_k_squared_gt_n, h_not_divisible]

lemma is_prime_helper_incr (k: Nat) (n: Nat) (h_k_squared_gt_n: k * k > n) (h_not_divisible: ∀ m, 2 ≤ m ∧ m < n → n % m ≠ 0) : is_prime_helper (k + 1) n = true :=
by
  unfold is_prime_helper
  simp [h_k_squared_gt_n, h_not_divisible]
  simp [Nat.mul_add]
  simp [Nat.mul_comm]
  simp [Nat.add_assoc]
